headline: One outage, told once
lede: sleepwatch v4 (#1406, merged as 0d24dba): a deep night whose ticks resumed in stages is now recorded as ONE window instead of stacked fragments, the forge board refuses to claim 'asleep RIGHT NOW' off a wire older than 24 hours, and every day the warden writes down how far the power log can actually see.

notes.text: coalesceWindows merges adjacent raw tick-gap segments (seam ≤ 2 ticks, chained) and retires raw claims a pmset window fully covers — the deep-dark e2e now pulses asleep=00:20-11:30 for the whole night instead of the last 6 hours.
Board age guard: LIVE strips drop beyond LIVE_SHOWN_MS (24 h) of pulse age; deriveFloor.pulseAge threads the WARDEN lamp's own clock into the banner. Retro windows survive — history is history.

Coverage honesty: the tick line names logspan=<min> once per UTC day, flagging logshort=1 when the log cannot reach the 48 h horizon — silent degradation becomes a visible ceiling. sleepwatchcheck 218→274 gates, five mutants proven red and restored.

Rule 4 honest count: three merged PRs in a row now touch no game code (#1405/#1409/#1412; last game merge #1400). Per-slot streak is 2. Semantics live in #1403, next titles in #1404 — both AWAITING Jon by Nov 3. The forge is product-dry, not idle-dry.
